VariableDeclarator->VariableDeclaration.encoding: one legacy declarator becomes one declaration envelope

SwitchCase->BlockStatement.encoding: case test and consequent statements are retained on a block-shaped node
SwitchCase->BlockStatement.semanticDelta: the target schema has no dedicated SwitchCase authoring kind

UnaryExpression->BinaryExpression.encoding: operator is prefixed with unary: and operand is stored as argument
UnaryExpression->BinaryExpression.semanticDelta: compatibility encoding only; not a canonical BinaryExpression authoring form

varKind->declarationKind.semanticDelta: missing legacy varKind defaults to let

value->argument.semanticDelta: field rename only for the supported return slice

condition->test.semanticDelta: field rename only for supported control-flow nodes

operand->argument.semanticDelta: used with the declared UnaryExpression compatibility encoding

args->arguments.semanticDelta: ordered call argument references are retained
